projects.title: Multi-Tenant Socratic EdTech RAG & Vision-Routing Tutor
projects.upwork_niche: Multi-tenant K-12 EdTech Socratic AI tutor with hierarchical textbook RAG, vision routing, and seasonal scale-to-zero architecture
projects.problem: K-12 schools need an AI tutor grounded in each school's exact textbooks and diagrams without leaking data across tenants, giving away direct answers, or burning money on idle GPUs during 165 vacation days.
projects.solution: Engineered a multi-tenant Socratic RAG & Vision-Routing platform with strict school isolation (PostgreSQL RLS DDL + runtime TenantContext guards), structure-aware textbook chunking (prose, tables, LaTeX equations, diagrams), SHA-256 vision-to-JSON cache routing (92.6% follow-up savings), FERPA/COPPA PII redaction, and an interactive seasonal scale-to-zero console.
highlights: Strict multi-tenant school isolation via PostgreSQL FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY blueprint and runtime TenantContext guards + bulk CSV roster onboarding
Structure-aware hierarchical textbook chunker keeping Markdown tables, LaTeX equations, and diagram blocks atomic with BM25 + dense RRF hybrid retrieval
Cost-aware model router with SHA-256 Vision-to-JSON caching (92.6% follow-up savings), 3-level Socratic anti-spoiler guard, FERPA/COPPA PII redaction, and 200-vs-165 seasonal cost simulator
